name: Boggard Scouting Party

items.name: Chorus of Croaks
items.text: The boggard scouting party unleashes a chorus of terrifying croaks. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes Frightened 1 unless they succeed at a DC 21 Will save save; those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

items.name: Coordinated Tongue Pull
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Several boggards use their tongues to grapple an enemy within 10 feet to pull them closer. The target must attempt a DC 21 Reflex save save. On a failure, they are Grabbed and pulled 5 feet closer to the scouting party. A creature grabbed in this way isn't Immobilized, but it can't move more than 10 feet from the scouting party. A creature can sever one of the tongues with a Strike against AC 21 that deals at least 5 slashing damage. This doesn't damage the scouting party.

items.name: Morningstar Massacre
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The boggards execute coordinated melee attacks against each enemy in a 5-foot emanation, with a DC 21 basic Reflex save save. The damage dealt depends on the number of actions.

1 1d6 untyped damage

2 2d6+7 untyped damage

3 2d6+11 untyped damage

items.name: Sling Barrage
items.text: The dreadknot draws and loads slings to launch a coordinated barrage. This barrage is a 10-foot burst within 50 feet that deals 3d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). When the scouting party is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a 5-foot burst.

items.name: Swamp Passage
items.text: A boggard scouting party ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

text: Boggard scouting parties run ahead of other boggard troops to get the lay of the land. They sometimes engage if they think they can quickly vanquish an enemy force.
